description: This file defines a function to compute the Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) metric based on availability, performance, and quality inputs. It provides calculations and percentage conversions for these metrics.

methods.name: computeOee({ availability, performance, quality })
methods.description: Calculates OEE as the product of availability, performance, and quality, each a value between 0 and 1, and returns an object with these values, the computed OEE, and their percentage equivalents.
